symptoms: Small yellowish-brown pustules (raised dots) mostly on the lower leaf surface
Orange-brown powdery spores rub off on fingers
Upper surface above pustules shows pale yellow patches
Severe attack: leaves dry, curl and drop early

severity_cues.advanced: Pustules across the canopy, bronzing and early leaf drop

favorable_conditions: Cool humid spells, dew, delayed canopy drying

treatment.summary: Protective systemic fungicide before the next wet spell
steps: Spray Propiconazole 25 EC at 1.0 ml per litre, repeat after 12 to 15 days if weather favors rust
Improve drying: irrigation in the morning, not evening
Destroy crop residue after the last picking
Rotate out of cotton next season where rust repeats

products.name: Propiconazole 25 EC
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period on cotton 14 days

organic: Wettable sulphur 80 WP at 2.0 to 2.5 g per litre, avoiding spray above 32 C

source.org: ICAR Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR), cotton disease advisory
source.title: Cotton: rust management

safety_notes: Wear gloves, mask and full sleeves while spraying
Do not pick cotton within 14 days of spray
